content.text:
Built **Slicebound**, a complete, playable Fruit Ninja-style game in `index.html`.

Swipe or drag through fruit to score and trigger automatic combo chains. Avoid bombs and dropped fruit—three misses end the round. The game also includes a 60-second timer, saved best score, sound toggle, pause/restart controls, and responsive touch support.

Checked the game in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes, and verified the JavaScript syntax. Assumed a single-player arcade mode with a 60-second round and three lives.
